stem:
Meera has a spring balance at home to weigh vegetables.
On its scale, the difference between two consecutive numbered marks is 2 N, and there are 10 equal small divisions between them.
What is the smallest value of weight she can read on this spring balance?

teacher.key_rationale: Smallest readable value = difference between numbered marks / number of small divisions = 2 N / 10 = 0.2 N, so option B.
